systems.country_label: Registre national de la population (enrôlement biométrique)
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Intérieur, de la Promotion de la Décentralisation et du Développement local
systems.tiers: enrolment at the 'centres compétents' as a permanent service since the 2025 legal reform; more than 5.1 million enrolled against 3.4 million in 2019, per the interior minister to the National Assembly on 18 June 2026; 36,516 enrolled in under a year under the open regime

systems.country_label: commissions locales chargées de l'identification et des statistiques
systems.tiers: 238 commissions constituted in all communes since late September 2025; they verify identity and decide enrolment in the population register
mobile field missions bringing civil-status services closer to citizens; a survey of citizens with enrolment problems registered more than 613,000

note: The minister's answers concern enrolment of persons in the biometric national population register, which the typology classes as identity; he speaks of modernising and digitising the civil-status system in general terms but states nothing about how or where a birth or death is registered.
